coverage_definition: Main-article source-shown cis/trans THF routes, feed preparations and isolated exploratory products. Allene axial configurations require separate metadata; mixtures and aggregate yields retain source scope. SI contains spectra only.

issues.detail: Ordinary canonical SMILES/SDF does not encode allene axial chirality. Axial descriptors and source locators distinguish 5a/5a prime, 15a/b, 16a/b, 27a/b and target epimers; identical ordinary SMILES are not evidence of identical full stereochemical identity.
issues.subject: all bromoallenes

issues.detail: Trans procedure explicitly uses iodide; cis procedure supplies a bromide preparation. No counterion exchange or iodide preparation is invented.
issues.subject: hex-3-enyl phosphonium iodide

issues.detail: Scheme 6 footnote limits characterization to TLC/crude NMR; later full experimental data for 22 do not supply full characterization of every 23-25 mixture.
Scheme 7 gives 94%; experimental section gives 93%. Preserve experimental value and scheme discrepancy.
issues.subject: C10

issues.detail: Scheme 6 reports 94%; narrative reports 93% for trisylation. Product is an inseparable mixture.
issues.subject: C07

issues.detail: Experimental prose positive sign conflicts with negative heading/negative rotation. Do not infer absolute configuration from rotation alone.
issues.subject: 2a'

issues.detail: Source-bound facts require independent chemist review.
